notes.title: v2.0.0 has Arrived
notes.content:
v2.0.0 of Cubit has been completed.

Here are new features of the Game:
-New Levels (Forest, City and Space)
-New UI
-New Power Up System
-New Shop for Power Up
-Some bug fixes.

Updates may be postponed for some Reasons. It may continue in as early as 6 Months but there might be some minor updates if needed.
